question: How can I track my order status?
answer: You can track your order by going to 'My Orders', selecting your order, and clicking 'Track Package' to see real-time courier updates.

question: What should I do if my order delivery is delayed?
answer: If your order has passed the expected delivery date, please check the tracking link for transit updates or wait 24-48 hours. If there is still no update, our support team will escalate it with the courier partner.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: Delivery address can only be changed before the order is dispatched. Go to 'My Orders' -> 'Edit Address'. Once dispatched, address changes cannot be processed.

question: How can I opt for express or same-day delivery?
answer: Express delivery availability depends on your pin code and the seller. If eligible, you will see an 'Express / Next-Day Delivery' option at checkout for a nominal fee.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
answer: Currently, we only ship to serviceable pin codes within India. International deliveries and overseas billing addresses are not supported.

question: How do I cancel my order before it ships?
answer: To cancel, go to 'My Orders', select the order, and click 'Cancel Order'. If the order has not been dispatched yet, the cancellation will be approved immediately.

question: Are there any cancellation fees or penalties?
answer: No, cancellation is completely free of charge if requested before the order is dispatched.

question: Can I cancel a single item from a multi-item order?
answer: Yes, visit 'My Orders', select the specific product you wish to cancel, and click 'Cancel Item'. The remaining items will be shipped as scheduled.

question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available for all pin codes?
answer: COD is available on eligible items and serviceable pin codes. You can check COD availability on the product page by entering your delivery pin code.

question: Money was deducted from my account, but my order is not placed. What should I do?
answer: If payment was debited but no order was created, your bank will automatically reverse the transaction within 3 to 5 business days.

question: What are the available No-Cost EMI options?
answer: No-Cost EMI is offered on major credit cards and select debit cards on orders above ₹3,000. Interest charged by the bank is provided as an upfront discount at checkout.

question: Can I change the payment method after placing the order?
answer: Payment methods cannot be altered once an order is placed. You will need to cancel the order before dispatch and place a fresh order with your preferred payment option.

question: What is the standard return window and policy?
answer: Most items have a 7-day return policy from the delivery date. Items must be unused, unwashed, with tags attached and original packaging intact.

question: How do I schedule a return pickup?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', choose the delivered item, tap 'Return / Exchange', select the reason, and pick a convenient date for doorstep pickup.

question: What if the courier agent does not show up for return pickup?
answer: Pickups are attempted up to 3 times. If the agent does not arrive on the scheduled day, your pickup will be automatically re-attempted the following business day.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
answer: Yes, select 'Exchange' under 'My Orders' and choose your desired replacement size or color of the same product. Once pickup is completed, the replacement is dispatched.

question: What should I do if I received a damaged or defective product?
answer: Please report damaged or defective items within 48 hours of delivery under 'My Orders' with photos of the package and item to request an immediate replacement.

question: An item or accessory is missing from my delivery box. How do I get it?
answer: Report missing items within 24 hours under 'My Orders' -> 'Help'. We will verify package weight logs and dispatch the missing accessory or initiate a replacement.

question: How long does it take to receive a refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 24 hours after the returned item passes quality inspection. The amount reflects in your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

question: Why has my refund not arrived after 7 business days?
answer: If 7 business days have passed since refund approval, please contact our support team with your refund ARN/reference number so we can check with our banking partners.

question: How will I receive the refund for a Cash on Delivery (COD) order?
answer: For COD orders, you will be prompted to add your bank account details or UPI ID under 'Refund Settings'. Once added, the refund will be credited via IMPS within 2 business days.

question: Can my refund be credited to my store wallet instead of bank?
answer: Yes, you can choose 'Store Credit / Wallet' during return creation for instant refund credit upon pickup without waiting for bank clearance.

question: How can I download the GST tax invoice for my purchase?
answer: To download the invoice, visit 'My Orders', select the order, and click 'Download Invoice'. The PDF will be downloaded immediately.

question: How do I update my registered phone number or email address?
answer: Go to 'Account Settings' -> 'Profile', edit your mobile number or email ID, and verify with an OTP sent to your existing and new credentials.

question: How do I reset my account password if forgotten?
answer: Click on 'Login', choose 'Forgot Password', enter your registered mobile number or email, and follow the password reset link or OTP sent to you.

question: How do I permanently delete my shopping account?
answer: To delete your account, navigate to 'Account Settings' -> 'Privacy & Security' -> 'Request Account Deletion'. All order histories and stored addresses will be permanently erased.

question: How do I claim brand warranty for electronics purchased here?
answer: You can claim warranty directly at any authorized brand service center using your tax invoice as proof of purchase.

question: How do I know if the products sold are 100% genuine and original?
answer: All products are sourced directly from verified authorized brand distributors and come with a 100% authenticity guarantee with official brand packaging.

question: How do I schedule installation or product demo for large appliances?
answer: Installation is auto-scheduled within 24-48 hours of delivery. A brand technician will call you prior to visiting your address.

question: Do you offer a price match or price drop refund if price decreases?
answer: Prices fluctuate based on ongoing sales and seller promotions. We currently do not offer price matching or partial refunds for subsequent price drops.
